text: Doing lateral raises every week... but your shoulders still look narrow?
Here's why. With dumbbells, the bottom half of every rep does almost nothing. The weight just hangs straight down.
A cable pulls from the side, so your side delts work from the very first inch.
Set the pulley at hand height. Stand side-on, an arm's length away, so the cable meets your arm at ninety degrees.
Lift with your elbow, lower slowly, and watch your shoulders get wider. Save this.
